blocks.name: Order of Reactivity
blocks.definition: know the order of reactivity of these metals: potassium, sodium, lithium, calcium, magnesium, aluminium, zinc, iron, copper, silver, gold

blocks.text: Carbon and the reactivity series mnemonic

blocks.md:
- Carbon is an important element and has its own place on the reactivity series
- Its use in the extraction of metals from their oxides and a more complete reactivity series with an accompanying mnemonic to help you memorise it is below
- “Please send lions, cats, monkeys and cute zebras into hot countries signed Gordon”

| **Metal** | **Abbreviation** |
|---|---|
| **Most reactive** |   |
| Potassium | P - Please |
| Sodium | S- Send |
| Lithium | L - Lions |
| Calcium | C - Cats |
| Magnesium | M - Monkeys |
| Aluminium | A - And |
| Carbon | C - Cute |
| Zinc | Z - Zebras |
| Iron | I - Into |
| Hydrogen | H - Hot |
| Copper | C - Countries |
| Silver | S - Signed |
| Gold | G - Gordon |
| **Least reactive** |   |
